about.title: About Me
about.summary1: Backend engineer focused on building scalable systems, REST APIs, and business-critical platforms. I specialize in translating business requirements into clean, maintainable code architectures with a strong backend-first approach. With expertise in Laravel and NestJS, I design systems that are reliable, secure, and production-ready.
about.summary2: I believe in writing code that solves real problems. I focus on backend fundamentals: database design, API architecture, authentication, permissions, and integrations. I stay current with best practices in software engineering and collaborate effectively with product and DevOps teams.

about.summary4: When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or mentoring junior developers in backend engineering and system design.
